meta.film_end_rule: last word + 1.0 s cut + 12.0 s end screen (script timing_model); back-time M14 to the real last frame of the EDL

conventions.gain_db: mix.json gain for a file normalised to about -20 LUFS (the ep01 sfx/norm convention). With the voice prepared to about -17 LUFS (like ep01 vo_proc_v3), gain -12 sits about 10-12 dB under the voice; beds at -7 to -9 sit at about -27 to -29 LUFS
conventions.t: file start time in the film (s); already includes the asset sync offset and a 0.08 s visual lead on word-anchored devices
conventions.bed: kind "bed" events need t_out, fade_in, fade_out and loop: mix.py has no such fields yet, so prebake each bed to its exact length or extend mix.py (spot_notes.md)
conventions.dur/fade_in/fade_out/src_in: trim the one-shot to dur (from src_in), with these fades, before mixing
conventions.comic: comedic SFX sit in the gap after the line, 0.8 s or shorter, about -16 to -18 dB, never over the last word (PLAYBOOK_craft 11)
conventions.enabled: false = designed but off by default
